title: Transforming Cities: The new network moving Bogotá forward
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: The new network moving Bogotá forward,” an urban initiative documented for Bogotá. It is included because it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.

intervention.objectives: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.

Why Bogotá is creating its first city-wide metro system 
 Getting around Colombia’s sprawling capital hasn’t always been easy. Residents have long relied on irregular and overcrowded buses. Discover how improved bus routes and the city’s first electric-powered metro network are set to transform the daily life of locals.
 MORE FROM THE ‘TRANSFORMING CITIES’ SERIES
